subject: literacy
concept: Decoding simple consonant-vowel-consonant (CVC) words by blending known letter sounds
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading explicit phonics sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sounds out each letter tile in a CVC word from left to right, then blends them
exercise.pictorial: Student matches decoded CVC words to their matching picture
exercise.abstract: Student reads simple CVC words aloud without picture support

misconception_flags: guesses the word from the first letter instead of decoding fully

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
